source: Separate sprite sheets referenced against the five approved Gummianden concepts.
preparation: Transparent crops normalized onto 1254 × 1254 PNG canvases. The picker uses the existing WebP preparation step.

sheets.prompt:
Create a production emoji SPRITE ATLAS of exactly six isolated individual head and upper-body poses of the SAME established yellow rubber duck from reference, on a TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. This is a single rectangular landscape atlas, 3 columns x 2 rows. Three stickers on top, three on bottom. Center coordinates as fraction of canvas: (1/6, 1/4), (1/2, 1/4), (5/6, 1/4), then (1/6, 3/4), (1/2, 3/4), (5/6, 3/4). All equally sized, stay WELL INSIDE its own invisible square cell with at least 10% empty transparent safety margin every side, no overlap. No grid lines. Cropped bust, no feet. Each pose is ONE separate clean sticker silhouette, no shadows outside. Preserve character identity from the supplied single-role reference: bright lemon yellow softly textured rubber, broad orange duck bill, little two-point yellow forelock visible, simple dark oval bead eyes, at most two small wing flippers (no hands), painted handcrafted illustration. Copy the distinctive wardrobe role from reference but no props from reference unless listed for a cell. Changes only in pose, emotional expression and explicit icon prop. Keep accessories simple, large and readable at 48px. No background tile, scene, colored frame, typography, letters, labels, captions, gradients behind figures, watermark or checkerboard. Use a crisp alpha cutout, true alpha outside.

Top-middle: duck cups a wing to side of head, listening attentively.
Top-right: duck looks up thinking, wing tucked under bill.
Bottom-left: duck tilts head in confusion, one large teal question mark above shoulder.
Bottom-middle: duck raises wing in discovery beside one bright light bulb.
Bottom-right: duck speaks with both wings open, one cream speech bubble with no text.
